days.summary: Default speed ~50% faster across GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol for subscribers and Sign in With ChatGPT partners (OpenCode, Pi, Amp, Devin, etc.). No user action needed; change should be felt within ~2 hours.
Full reset processed after the community vote, on top of four ships: 2.1 Auto-review free for ChatGPT sign-ins, 2.2 simpler API rate-limit tiers, 2.3 Meetings note-taker plugin, 2.4 Decisions API.

3.1 GPT-6 with Intelligent UI rolled out to all ChatGPT users, plus a banked reset (confirmed landed in every paid account) to celebrate a new high of 40M active users across Codex and ChatGPT Work. 3.2 (encore, late evening PT): Codex Cloud silently re-shipped; Tibo says it's "pretty good now" (quoting the new Codex Cloud + Tailscale tailnet integration).

4.1 Instant steering so the model reacts much faster to adjustments and course-corrects in realtime without wasting effort. 4.2 GPT-6.1 Sol ultrafast rolling out in API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work (near-Astra intelligence at up to 8x Sol Standard).

5.1 Composer predictions in the Codex desktop app (beta): Codex suggests your next message based on the conversation and how you talk to it; included in Pro plans without consuming usage. 5.2 (dots edition): you can now create and text your dot entirely from the ChatGPT mobile app on iOS and Android.
Global usage reset for everyone (propagated by end of day).

7.1 Default context length for GPT-6.1 Sol increased to 500k when used through Codex & Work, up from 272k (~80%). It reduces compactions and helps tasks that need a lot of context and nuance over time; carefully tested as the new sweet spot, still overridable higher or lower, with a 1M maximum. 7.2 No long-context fees for GPT-6.1 Sol when drawing usage from the subscription.
Global usage reset for everyone, landing by end of day PST (confirmed done).
9.1 ChatGPT & Codex desktop apps now store state on disk more efficiently, cutting the amount stored on disk by about 60% (a fix for power users running out of disk space).
Global usage reset (Day 10/ Reset); Tibo confirmed "Done and dusted."

11.1 Landed compute and product changes that very significantly decrease "Selected model is at capacity" errors; when it still happens, the request should eventually continue on its own instead of blocking.

12.1 Improvements to Codex & Work that increase the effective usage you get: context is reused across subagents, kept cached longer, and request routing is improved to raise cache hits. 12.2 GPT-6 Astra Pro in ChatGPT significantly improved for all Pro users: faster responses, better use of plugins and tools, and multiple agents working on parts of a task in parallel. 12.3 Dots now on your Home Screen (update your app to get it).
Global usage reset for everyone (Day 13 / limit reset), landing sometime today by end of day PST.
Small quality of life improvement: you can now edit previous messages within a thread in the desktop app.
Global usage reset for everyone ("we're still cooking... and reset. Enjoy.").
Prompt caching for 12 hours in the API, and for logged-in users across Codex & Work the cache is kept forever, so resuming an old conversation always hits the cache with no penalty.
Day 17 usage reset for everyone ("Bet you thought we forgot, but no, it's reset day today.").

Day 18 usage reset for everyone, alongside Decisions API going GA, OpenResponses joining the Linux Foundation, performance improvements, and Uber going all-in on Codex & Work ("But yes… that’s a reset!").
Small updates: calls connect much faster for Dots, changing reasoning mid-conversation in Codex & Work no longer invalidates the cache, and an updated Codex CLI.
Day 20 "Rest and reset": usage reset for everyone, to be fully propagated by midnight PST (confirmed later that night: "It is all propagated. Enjoy some mad codexing tomorrow.").
Day 21 usage reset for everyone ("Wonder what happens the remaining seven days. But today is a reset.").

GPT-6.1 Terra is back: OpenAI's first model significantly better at writing, personality and nuanced understanding of requests, very good at computer use, with 2X more usage than 6.1 Sol across API and subscriptions.

Day 23 usage reset for everyone, landing by midnight PST (he joked it was the much-requested iCloud Mail & Calendar plugins: "Just kidding, today is a reset."; confirmed later that night: "And it's done.").
Text your dot: give it a task by text, photos or voice notes over iMessage or RCS and it texts you back with proactive updates (preview for Pro users in the US).
Doubled usage limits for all Pro 100/200/500 tiers and Business Premium, effective today; Pro 200 limits won't be reduced, and extended dot limits stay (separate from default usage).
